_comment_setup: Winter→Spring held-out setup for Optuna tuning / deployment simulation. train_series = four winter dates (80% train / 20% val). test_series = five spring-drift dates (7.03, 15.03, 5.04, 11.04, 18.04) — fully held out from the encoder, used as the Optuna objective. Mirrors test_series in configs/contrastive/encoder.json.
_comment_reset_instructions: To revert to the production encoder setup (all series in train_series, stratified 80/15/5), move all series into train_series, set test_series=[], and add test_fraction=0.05.
_comment_new_series: ha-25.04.2026 (Haus A, has leakage) and hb-26.04.2026 (Haus B, NO leakage files — AUC undefined, only NoFlow OOD reference) added to test_series so they stay out of encoder training. Cross-house mixing into train_series is a separate experiment (see CLAUDE.md §'Waiting for More Data' priority 3).
